digest.component_or_area: code review project extension / rebar framework
propositions: Pass 1 must discover grounded candidate findings only and must not assess validity, severity, impact, confidence, policy, or remediation.
Pass 2 must independently answer atomic validity and impact questions only and must not discover new findings, decide outcomes, or prescribe fixes.
Pass 3 must apply deterministic thresholds without an LLM and must not gather new evidence or coach.
Pass 4 must offer non-prescriptive guidance only and must not re-verify findings, alter decisions, or dictate exact implementations.

The criterion's own prompt must emit evidence-grounded findings without severity, confidence, or suggested_fix fields and must distinguish operative instructions from documentation, require identifiable phase ownership, and abstain when ownership is unclear.

A balanced twelve-case eval corpus with RP-F1..RP-F6 must fire and RP-N1..RP-N6 must not fire, achieving perfect recall, zero false-accept, unity agreement, and kappa at least 0.70 across three runs with per-case stability at least 2/3.
